limitations: The proof concerns the actual extracted typed receipt validator and pure revoke transition; JSON conversion, transport phase placement, TLS and remote commit/SQL/durability remain explicit adapters under COORD-OPERATOR-RUST-01.
A lying or rolled-back coordinator can misreport state. Receipt validation is not remote attestation, transaction identity, anti-rollback protection or distributed consensus.

Operator transport failures after possible mutation submission are outcome_unknown; status is diagnostic and never triggers an automatic replay. Member transport failures retain revoked; positive member acknowledgements are now complete and typed in Python as in Rust.
The new operator client is host-only and does not make operator credentials or actions available to guest protocol handlers. The experimental AIVM integration and co-located copy are unchanged.
No broad Python/Rust parity, whole-service confidentiality, complete native I/O mediation, live provider, VM or physical TPM result is established.
